data.reason: The seen-reviewer subagent returned nine findings at note 32, three of them worth the return on their own. F1: routed() reads the branch, and actions/checkout leaves HEAD detached on a pull_request event, so doctor reports drift on the committed implementer copies of any commit routed below opus and CI's self-check fails on the pull request of a commit that is green on push. F2: ran_on reads model off the record envelope rather than record['data'] and indexes the tdd advance by route position, so the column SEEN-109's window is made of is null for every slice. F5: in shadow the work runs on the session's model while cost_cents prices it at the routed model's, so the sprint report SEEN-109 decides from shows a saving that has not happened.
